data.gender_notes: Pacifica is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'pax', meaning 'peace' and 'ficare', meaning 'to make'. A name symbolizing tranquility and calmness, similar to the serene Pacific Ocean. The name Pacifica carries the meaning “Peaceful ocean” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Pacifica usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful ocean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner peace and calmness in times of turmoil.
data.etymology: Pacifica belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peaceful ocean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pacifica total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: פאסיפיקה
in_hebrew.meaning: משמעות השם פאסיפיקה היא שלום ושלווה באוקיינוס השקט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם פאסיפיקה נגזר מהמילה הלטינית 'פאקס' שפירושה שלום, והמילה 'מר' שפירושה ים או אוקיינוס. השם פאסיפיקה משלב את הרעיון של שלום ושלווה עם תיאור של מקום שקט ורגוע, כמו האוקיינוס השקט. השם פאסיפיקה הוא שם נוצרי שמשקף את השאיפה לשלום ושלווה בלבם של המאמינים.

in_greek.name: Παсиφική
in_greek.meaning: Η Παсиφική σημαίνει ειρήνη και ηρεμία στον ωκεανό
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Παсиφική προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη 'pax' που σημαίνει ειρήνη και τη λέξη 'mar' που σημαίνει θάλασσα ή ωκεανός. Το όνομα Παсиφική συνδυάζει την έννοια της ειρήνης και της ηρεμίας με την περιγραφή ενός ήσυχου και γαλήνιου τόπου, όπως ο ωκεανός. Το όνομα Παсиφική είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που αντανακλά την επιθυμία για ειρήνη και ηρεμία στην καρδιά των πιστών.

data.cultural_impact: The name Pacifica is a tribute to the tranquil Pacific Ocean and its historical significance in maritime history. It represents a hope for peace, stability, and unity - values associated with calm waters and clear horizons. In various cultures, the Pacific Ocean is considered a symbol of connections and harmony due to its vastness and constancy.
data.spiritual_significance: This name invokes potential spiritual meanings, such as a call to find inner peace or a reminder of God's peace-giving presence. In Christianity, the name Pacifica is reminiscent of Jesus as the Prince of Peace - a testament to his calming influence and ability to bring peace to troubled hearts and minds.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Pacifica signifies peace and calmness, evoking the tranquil waters of the Pacific Ocean. It is a reminder of the calming presence of God, offering solace and serenity in times of turmoil.

historical_references.reference: The name Pacifica was given to a Spanish mission and settlement in California in 1776 by Father Junipero Serra. It was the 8th mission he founded and was located in the Monterey Bay area. The name was chosen to honor the concept of peace and tranquility.
historical_references.context: Founding of Mission San Carlos Borromeo de Carmelo, also known as Mission Carmel or Mission San Carlos, near Monterey Bay, California, United States.

historical_references.reference: The name Pacifica was also used for a town and post office in California in the late 1800s. The town was located on the Pacific Ocean and was named by Leland Stanford, who was the Governor of California at the time. He chose the name to honor the ocean and the peaceful, idyllic setting.
historical_references.context: Establishment of the town of Pacifica, California, United States.
